title: Comunidad Andina
goal: Read how the 1969 Andean Pact preceded Mercosur by over two decades, losing Chile in 1976 and Venezuela in 2006 while reorganizing as the Comunidad Andina in 1996 with its own parliament and court.

items: State what was signed in 1969 and by which countries.
Explain why Chile left the bloc in 1976.
Use por su cuenta to describe acting independently.
